mappings.note: Translation v1 contains only the title/introductory clause. The actual prayer text ('Herre, hvor mange...') is moved to translation v2.
Translation v2 contains the first sentence of the prayer found in osmain v1. The second sentence ('Mange reiser seg mot meg') is also here, but the title is missing.
Content matches osmain v2 (Mange sier om min sjel... Sela), though phrasing is slightly modernized.
Content matches osmain v3 (Men du, Herre... løfter mitt hode).
Content matches osmain v4 (Høyt roper jeg... Sela).
Content matches osmain v5 (Jeg la meg ned... holder meg oppe).
Content matches osmain v6 (Jeg frykter ikke... fra alle kanter).
Content matches osmain v7 (Reis deg... knust de ugudeliges tenner).
Content matches osmain v8 (Frelsen tilhører... Sela).

extraContent.description: The introductory title 'En salme av David da han flyktet for sin sønn Absalom' is split from the main text of osmain v1 and placed as a standalone verse in the translation. In osmain, this title is part of verse 1, but in dnb2011_nb, it is verse 1, pushing the prayer text to verse 2.
